title: Welcome to Brookfield!
body:
## Welcome to Brookfield! A short guide for visitors

Brookfield is a small, friendly town. You can walk everywhere!

**Main Street** is the heart of the town. There's a bank, a post office and a big supermarket. The supermarket is open every day from 7 a.m. to 10 p.m.

**Food:** Try Rosie's Diner, across from the bank. You can have a great breakfast there for $9. There isn't a fast-food restaurant in town, but there are three nice cafés.

**Culture:** The museum is on Park Avenue, next to the library. You can't take photos inside the museum, but you can visit it for free on Sundays.

**Parks:** Lake Park is behind the train station. You can rent a bike, or you can swim in the lake in summer. Please don't feed the ducks!

**Getting here:** From the train station, turn left and walk two blocks. The tourist office is on the corner of Main Street and Park Avenue, between the bank and the pharmacy. It's open Monday to Saturday.

Have a great time in Brookfield!
